# Daily Report — 2026-08-07

## Task Completed
Added `cancel_flow_execution` tool to `flow_tools.py`.  
The tool PATCHes `sys_flow_context/{sys_id}` with `state="cancelled"` to stop a
running Flow Designer execution.  An optional `cancel_reason` parameter is stored
as `work_notes` for audit purposes.  A 404 guard returns a clear error message
when the execution record does not exist.  The tool is registered in the
`platform_developer` and `full` tool packages.
